lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
በገና ሓዙ ከበሮ ውቕዑ
ካብ ዓለም ሰማይ መላእክት ንዑ
ውሽጢ መቕደሱ ቁሙ ካህናቱ
ተመስገን በሉ ንእግዚአብሔር ምስጋና ኣቕርቡ
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]ያሬድ ካብ ኣዕዋፍ ብዝሰምዖ ዜማ ተመስገን በሉ ንእግዚኣብሔር/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ከነቕርበሉ ፍረ ከናፍርና ተመስገን በሉ ንእግዚኣብሔር/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ትሕቲ ጽላሉ ስለ ዘዕረፈና ተመስገን በሉ ንእግዚኣብሔር/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ንዘድሓነና ኣብ ጊዜ መከራና ተመስገን በሉ ንእግዚኣብሔር/2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ነቶም ግፉዓት ንዝተሸገሩ ተመስገን በሉ ንእግዚኣብሔር /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ዝማጎተሎም ኣቦ ድኻታት ተመስገን በሉ ንእግዚኣብሔር /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ነዝይመሉ ብከበሮ ጸናጽል ተመስገን በሉ ንእግዚኣብሔር /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ንዝረድኣና ዕልል (2) ንበል ተመስገን በሉ ንእግዚኣብሔር /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ሓቂ ዝፈቱ ምሕረት ዝሃበና ተመስገን በሉ ንእግዚኣብሔር /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ሰናይ ገሩልና ዘልዓለም ንዓና ተመስገን በሉ ንእግዚኣብሔር /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ፍሉይ በልዎ ሓያል’ዩ ጐይታና ተመስገን በሉ ንእግዚኣብሔር /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ከነቕርበሉ ንስሙ ምስጋና ተመስገን በሉ ንእግዚኣብሔር /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ኣብ ሰማይ መን’ዩ ዝወዳደረካ ተመስገን በሉ ንእግዚኣብሔር/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ኣምላኽ ኣማልኽት ጐይታ ጎይቶት ኢኻ በሉ ንእግዚኣብሔር/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ምድሪ ተንቀጥቅጥ ትዘምር ንኽብሩ በሉ ንእግዚኣብሔር/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ሰማይ’ውን ይርዓድ ይናወጽ ጠፈሩ በሉ ንእግዚኣብሔር/2/[[/highlight]]
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Begena hazu kebero wiqhʿu
Kab ʿalem semay melaʾikt niʿu
Wisht'i meqhdesu qumu kahnatu
Temesgen belu niʾigziʾabher misgana ʾaqhribu
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]Yared kab ʾaʿiwaf bizsemʿo zema temesgen belu niʾigziʾabher/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Keneqhribelu fre kenafrina temesgen belu niʾigziʾabher/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Tihti tsilalu sile zeʿirefena temesgen belu niʾigziʾabher/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Nizedhanena ʾab gize mekerana temesgen belu niʾigziʾabher/2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]Netom gifuʿat nizteshegeru temesgen belu niʾigziʾabher /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Zimagotelom ʾabo dikhatat temesgen belu niʾigziʾabher /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Nezyimelu bikebero tsenatsl temesgen belu niʾigziʾabher /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Nizredʾana ʿill (2) nibel temesgen belu niʾigziʾabher /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]Haqi zifetu mihret zihabena temesgen belu niʾigziʾabher /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Senay gerulna zelʿalem niʿana temesgen belu niʾigziʾabher /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Filuy belwo hayal’yu goytana temesgen belu niʾigziʾabher /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Keneqhribelu nismu misgana temesgen belu niʾigziʾabher /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ʾAb semay men’yu ziwedadereka temesgen belu niʾigziʾabher/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ʾAmlakh ʾamalkhit goyta goytot ʾikha belu niʾigziʾabher/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Midri tenqet'qit' tizemr nikhbiru belu niʾigziʾabher/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Semay’win yirʿad yinawets t'eferu belu niʾigziʾabher/2/[[/highlight]]
